scripts:
set output to ""
set startD to (current date) - (time of (current date))
set endD to startD + (1 * days)
tell application "Calendar"
  launch
  repeat with c in calendars
    repeat with e in (every event of c whose start date ≥ startD and start date < endD)
      set output to output & (summary of e) & " at " & (time string of (start date of e)) & ". "
    end repeat
  end repeat
end tell
return output
